reviews.title: Does everyone else in your house love how extremely loud your keyboard is???
reviews.comment:
Neither does my family, and at this price, I couldn't resist. Great fit, especially if you have wrist issues. Keys are really nice and quite for those late night gaming sessions and they're easy to press. Value, I can't say enough. I've had one for about a year or so now,( no problems or issues at all) and just bought another for a second rig. It's been used heavily, spilled on, and knocked around a bit, yet still works perfect.  Weighs, performs and looks way more expensive than it is and the rbg ties right into Signal without an issue. Plus, nobody yells at you at 3 am!
Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Pete K

reviews.title: Works Great
reviews.comment: This keyboard works great for my son! The compact ten keyless design saves space and is perfect for gaming setups. The keys feel nice to use and the RGB lighting adds a fun touch. Overall, a solid keyboard for both gaming and everyday use. 🎮
reviews.author: JKPrince

reviews.title: A lot for a little
reviews.comment: Well its an amazing value for a quality Steelseies TKL Keyboard. Ive become very fond of it the more I use it. The keyboard is very well made. All of my keystroke activate precisely. No mistakes for missed or gently touched keys. This is one to keep in your arsenal. If you look at the prices for other SteelSeries gaming devices, there is a huge swing. I mean this amazingly good keyboard for around $30 to their others at $200. Im sure the technology is higher for their pro gaming products, you can feel and see some differences. I just dont have the coin to buy those higher priced devices! Im happy to own my steelseries TKL keyboard! The LEDs are beautiful and bright. They are highly customizable  but Im happy with the rainbow scrolling. I have a steelseries I purchased. Its a win-win!
reviews.author: dcime

reviews.title: Great budget keyboard!
reviews.comment:
I have been using this keyboard ongoing a year now, and it has held up extremely well!
I had been searching for a new keyboard since my laptop keyboard had some missing keys and wasn't super comfortable at the time. I had never really looked into gaming keyboards before and really just needed something affordable. At the time that I purchased this keyboard, it was on sale for around $24, which was a great price point and one of the main reasons for my purchase.
I mainly just needed a keyboard for everyday uses and some light gaming (nothing too intense) and this keyboard has been perfect for these necessities!
Some pros I've come across with this keyboard:
When it came in, I immediately enjoyed the size, and the fact that there were floating keys. Very different from what I was used to, but I love the way this keyboard looks and feels. The compact size was perfect for my needs, and it fits nicely on my desk. The lighting looks great, and I enjoy that you can increase/decrease the brightness through the keyboard itself instead of going through the app. Going back to the keys, they're very easy to pop off, making the keyboard simple to clean, which is very important for me as I have a dog who does not stop shedding! The board itself is all plastic, and pretty lightweight, but despite that it doesn't feel overly cheap.
Some cons:
I do not really like the app that comes with this keyboard. The UI is a bit clunky, and while I love being able to customize the lights, some of the lighting settings do not work properly with this specific model. The keyboard itself is a great size for my desk, but not optimal whatsoever for travel, as it is pretty large even though it's more compact than a full-sized board. The keys are pretty clacky, and they are pretty loud, but I believe keyboards like these can be modified to suit whatever your needs would be!
Overall, I've enjoyed this keyboard, it's definitely a great value for what I paid for it, and it holds up very well for what I need it for. It looks nice, feels nice, and is a pretty great keyboard if you're on a budget!
reviews.author: Arron Lara

reviews.title: Great keyboard
reviews.comment: This is a very nice keyboard for the price. It is not a mechanical keyboard, but it still feels very nice to type on, and it sounds great! Great budget keyboard, the lighting looks very good and is easy to customize. You cant customize the individual keys, its sections across the keyboard the horizontal ways. Everything feels really good quality, it's all plastic but nice plastic. I definitely would recomend this keyboard.
